Visit us here: https://www.campsite.bio/cprnj

Complete Physical Rehabilitation provides Physical Therapy, Acupuncture, and Wellness services in Elizabeth and Jersey City.  In addition to general Physical Therapy, we focus on:

Vestibular (Dizziness) Physical Therapy
McKenzie Spine Physical Therapy
Joint Physical Therapy
Runners Training & Physical Therapy

Since 2004, our physical therapists have excelled at offering the most comprehensive PT programs available, centered on our one-on-one Physical Therapy & Acupuncture services.

We are the FIRST clinic to offer LightForce® laser therapy treatment programs and the AlterG® Anti-Gravity Treadmill in Elizabeth & Jersey City.

In addition,  we are one of the top specialists in Jersey City and Elizabeth for vestibular (dizziness/vertigo) rehab. We also are certified specialists in back pain and sciatica using the McKenzie Method®, certified LSVT BIG specialists for Parkinson’s Disease, & specialize in treating runners.
